notablePrerequisites: You have cast your commander from the command zone at least twice this game.
description:
Activate Jirina by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Jirina enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Jirina trigger, creating at least two 1/1 Human Soldier creature tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Jirina.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Human Soldiers, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.
If you've cast your commander at least four times from the command zone this game, this combo nets infinite creature tokens.
